liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity fell by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} in undrawn committed facilities, down {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2025}}, and cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}}.

Debt due within one year was reduced by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}} by liquidity, and borrowings due within two years of {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}} are covered {{liquidity_to_borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}} by liquidity, so near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders, fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, and FCF after leases to debt declined by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, while contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} were reduced by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}}, so a larger share of the cash base is customers' prepayments.
